fact: On 4-5 December 2024 the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy held a round table on the 'stratégie nationale de digitalisation de l'État 2023-2026', described as the object of the concertation with partners, with the minister citing its implementation since 2022 and no adopting act named.
title: Conakry : fin de la table ronde sur la stratégie nationale de digitalisation de l'État en Guinée
